class.name: JRPGBattleRules
class.brief_description: Tunable numbers of the JRPG battle system.
class.description: Holds the battle numbers a project can retune: critical and guard strength, speed variation, buffs, TP, time progression, escape chances and parameter limits. Rates ending in [code]_bp[/code] are basis points (10000 = 100%). The reasons behind the defaults are explained in Talewright's battle defaults guide.

members.member: How many buff (or debuff) levels a parameter can stack.
Change of a parameter per buff level, as a fraction of its base value.
Damage multiplier of a critical hit.
How strongly the party's agility advantage over the enemies raises the escape chance.
Escape chance when party and enemies are equally fast.
Escape chance added after each failed attempt in the same battle.
Damage reduction for a guarding battler at 100% guard effect.
Highest possible value of the other parameters.
Random variation of action speed in turn-based battles.
Highest TP a battler can have.
TP a battler gains whenever it takes HP damage.
Additional TP gained in proportion to the damage taken relative to max HP.
Battlers start each battle with a random TP from 0 to this value.
In time progression battles, how many simulation steps (1/60 s) the fastest battler needs to fill its gauge.
